lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in a multi-row grid pattern posterior to the pectoral fin. The spacing is relatively uniform along the horizontal axis, with clusters forming vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the primary circular blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define the grid structure across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp pixel intensity transition from light (top) to shadow (bottom), extending from the anterior region toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: Small, dark, elongated pixel clusters representing hitchhiking organisms are visible near the ventral-lateral boundary and trailing the pectoral fin.
